page_note: This page contains a sustained microcosmic correspondential teaching: the body is an encampment with gates (sense-organs), guards, and archons attempting to enter; the Mind of Light is the queen/keeper holding the keys. Both sides of the mapping stay within the cosmic-anthropological system. Only the chapter heading and the opening 'Illuminator says' formula are clearly editorial frame; the closing seg 32 pivots toward hortatory ('behold the adornment of works'). Page is heavily damaged (39%) but the teaching voice is dominant throughout.
